```xml
<screen id="account" label="Account" weft="0.1">
  <heading id="title" level="1">Account</heading>
  <tabs id="tabs" label="Account sections">
    <tab id="tab-overview" label="Overview">
      <text id="account-name" text="{$.account.name}"/>
      <text id="account-email" text="{$.account.email}"/>
    </tab>
    <tab id="tab-billing" label="Billing">
      <text id="plan" text="{$.billing.plan}"/>
      <button id="change-plan" variant="primary" on-press="billing.change">Change plan</button>
    </tab>
    <tab id="tab-team" label="Team">
      <list id="members">
        <each id="members-each" as="member" in="{$.team}">
          <item id="member">
            <text id="member-name" text="{$member.name}"/>
          </item>
        </each>
      </list>
    </tab>
    <tab id="tab-security" label="Security">
      <button id="enable-2fa" on-press="security.enable">Enable 2FA</button>
    </tab>
  </tabs>
</screen>
```
